decision: The read-only audit passed. Exactly the 100 locked coherence rows for each of the six preregistered B40/B80 systems are eligible for the evaluator-blind v19 prompt-span execution path. The next experiment is limited to those 600 rows; the other 1,300 historical rows per system remain immutable.
authorized_next_action: Build an ephemeral signed v19 package from each exact B40/B80 model-router-residual-guard lineage, execute only its 100 locked coherence rows on CUDA, merge those measurements with the bound historical non-coherence rows, and recompute every existing quality gate without training or final-test access.
claim_boundary: Eligibility only. No hypothetical upper score is promoted. Stable sufficient-information frontier, adjacent lower failure, matched LoRA/distillation, final test, Phase 4, and ABI superiority remain unproven.
